name: DataTraderH4Breakout
summary: This EA implements a New York session open breakout strategy that forms a range during the first 4 hours of NY local time (00:00-04:00 NY) and enters trades on M5 when price breaks above resistance or below support. Stop loss is placed at the lowest low or highest high of the preceding candles within the range, with take profit set at 2x the stop loss distance. It includes DST-aware time conversion between server time and New York time.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了纽约开盘时段突破策略，在纽约本地时间前4小时（00:00-04:00）形成价格区间，随后在M5周期上价格突破支撑或阻力时入场。止损设为区间内前期K线的最低低点或最高高点，止盈为止损距离的2倍。内置了服务器时间到纽约时间的夏令时转换逻辑。
strategy_analysis: 该策略属于典型的时段突破策略，核心概念是在纽约开盘前4小时形成的价格区间内寻找突破机会。入场条件：当M5收盘价从下方突破区间底部（支撑位）时做多，从上方突破区间顶部（阻力位）时做空。出场条件采用固定止损止盈方式，止损为突破前区间内15根K线的最低低/最高高，止盈为止损距离的2倍（1:2风险回报比）。仓位管理采用固定手数，通过CheckVolumeValue函数校验最小/最大手数、手数步长和保证金是否充足。资金管理方面仅检查可用保证金，未使用动态仓位调整或风险百分比计算。策略每天在纽约时段重新计算区间，当日仅在没有持仓时才开新仓。
strategy_analysis_en: This is a classic session breakout strategy that identifies a price range during the first 4 hours of New York local time and trades breakouts from that range. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the M5 close crosses above the range bottom from below, and a sell signal triggers when the M5 close crosses below the range top from above. Exit conditions use fixed stop loss and take profit, where the SL is placed at the lowest low (for buys) or highest high (for sells) found by scanning up to 15 preceding M5 candles within the range, and TP is set at 2x the SL distance for a 1:2 risk-reward ratio. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size with validation via CheckVolumeValue which checks min/max volume, volume step alignment, and sufficient free margin. Money management is minimal — there is no dynamic position sizing or percentage-based risk calculation. The EA only opens one position at a time and resets the range daily at the start of each NY session.

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，纽约时段突破是经过验证的经典交易概念
内置完整的DST（夏令时）转换逻辑，确保时间窗口准确
止损止盈有明确规则，风险回报比固定为1:2
检查了最小/最大手数、步长和保证金，避免无效订单
每日重置区间，避免陈旧数据影响判断
pros_en: Clear and logical strategy based on the well-validated NY session breakout concept
Comprehensive DST conversion logic ensures accurate time window calculation
Defined stop loss and take profit rules with a fixed 1:2 risk-reward ratio
Validates lot size against min/max/step and checks free margin before placing orders
Daily range reset prevents stale data from affecting trading decisions
cons: 固定手数无动态仓位管理，无法根据账户风险调整仓位大小
止损搜索仅限15根K线，极端行情可能找不到合适的止损位
无滑点和点差过滤，在流动性低的时段可能产生不利成交
服务器DST切换日期使用固定月/日而非真正的DST规则，可能产生时间偏差
缺少最大回撤保护或日亏损限制，连续亏损时风险不可控
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing with no dynamic position management — cannot scale risk based on account equity
Stop loss search is limited to 15 candles, which may miss appropriate SL levels in volatile conditions
No spread or slippage filter, potentially leading to unfavorable fills during low-liquidity periods
Server DST switching uses hardcoded month/day instead of actual DST rules, risking time window misalignment
No max drawdown protection or daily loss limit, creating unbounded risk during losing streaks
improvements: 增加基于账户净值百分比的动态仓位管理，替代固定手数
添加点差过滤和最大滑点限制，避免在高点差时段开仓
实现每日最大亏损限制和连续亏损后的仓位缩减机制
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage instead of fixed lots
Implement spread filtering and maximum slippage limits to avoid trading during high-spread periods
Add daily max loss limits and position reduction after consecutive losses for better capital preservation

risk_points: 固定手数无风险百分比控制，小账户可能过度杠杆
服务器夏令时切换日期使用硬编码值，可能与实际经纪商设置不符导致时间窗口偏移
无日亏损上限或回撤保护机制
risk_points_en: Fixed lot size without risk percentage control may over-leverage small accounts
Hardcoded DST switching dates may not match actual broker settings, causing time window drift
No daily loss cap or drawdown protection mechanism
